mapper.select: SELECT * FROM loan_interest_accrual WHERE loan_id = #{loanId} ORDER BY accrual_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_interest_accrual (loan_id, loan_no, company_id, company_name, accrual_date, accrual_amount, principal, interest_rate, days, accrual_type, status) VALUES (#{loanId}, #{loanNo}, #{companyId}, #{companyName}, #{accrualDate}, #{accrualAmount}, #{principal}, #{interestRate}, #{days}, #{accrualType}, #{status})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM loan_interest_accrual WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(accrual_amount) as totalAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN accrual_type = '正常' THEN accrual_amount ELSE 0 END) as normalAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN accrual_type = '逾期' THEN accrual_amount ELSE 0 END) as overdueAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN accrual_type = '罚息' THEN accrual_amount ELSE 0 END) as penaltyAmount FROM loan_interest_accrual WHERE status = 1
